preconditions: Orthophoto tile coordinates and bytes are captured
Matching seamlessphoto_spec GeoJSON tile is captured and hash-bound
decisionLogic: Classify the center and four inset corners of every displayed orthophoto tile against the official metadata polygons. Report consistency only when all five locations have one identical, complete source/date classification.
uncertainty: Five-point sampling does not prove uniform metadata over every pixel between sample points.
exclusions: Does not infer lithology or any subsurface boundary
Does not call a five-point-consistent tile uniformly covered
validationMethod: Polygon, hole, overlap, missing-field and real-route tests
reopenCondition: GSI changes the endpoint/schema, a tile is mixed/unresolved, or pixel-complete polygon overlay is required
